meshes.assembly_method: CSR batches of up to2048 elements
meshes.geometry_scope: X-half band, complete actual front and rear width, single front bore retained
meshes.load_method: 2 N uniform traction integrated over full guide bottom
limits: Ideal X symmetry; one front crown node restrains Y and Z, one rear crown node restrains Z to remove rigid roll
Restraints are numerical datums, not scalp contact
Different load distribution and crown restraints from quarter-width study; difference cannot be attributed solely to removed Y symmetry
Peak stress not used as physical strength or comfort result
Assumed E 2000 MPa and Poisson 0.35; no guide, locking or full assembly contact
